name: ARTS Group Co., Ltd
summary: ARTS Group Co., Ltd., headquartered in Suzhou, China, is actively engaged in the complete lifecycle of engineering and construction ventures throughout the country. Their expertise spans design, material acquisition, construction, and operational management for a diverse portfolio of projects. The company's service offerings are comprehensive, encompassing project oversight and management, detailed engineering blueprints, investment and financial facilitation, and general contracting duties. They cater to numerous sectors, including commercial offices, hospitality establishments, cultural and athletic venues, educational facilities, industrial complexes, historical restoration efforts, healthcare institutions, and logistics centers. Additionally, they provide specialized landscape services. Established in 1995, the firm rebranded to ARTS Group Co., Ltd. in August 2015, having previously operated as Suzhou Industrial Park Design & Research Institute Co., Ltd.
